lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the adult torso; spacing is approximately equidistant with slight compression in the central torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 9th line from the anterior, splitting into two distinct segments toward the ventral edge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed segments and abbreviated line terminations observed in the 4th, 5th, and 7th lines from the anterior torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 8 high-contrast spots located on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb of the adult specimen.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-thigh align to form a horizontal geometric line segment parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark dorsal crest along the spine and white chevron-like markings on the muzzle and sub-orbital regions of both specimens.
